opening.argument: The speaker ties financial benefit directly to network building and higher program slots. He tells viewers, “Build a small network in Farisit It will give you lifetime benefit,” then explains that higher slots bring earnings from X Gold and X Force. The displayed Forsage Programs screen shows X3 and X4 sections with upgrade controls, while notifications show a new partner joining and BUSD receipts at program levels. The profile also displays a Partners count alongside the Forsage Programs section. Taken together, these statements and displays connect the represented rewards to recruiting or expanding a network and to moving into higher paid slots, consistent with a Forsage-style tiered matrix.
